name: Aiudara Seeker
body_text: The aiudara of Alseta’s Ring have become more well known, and you are interested in learning more about them. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Portal Lore skill. You gain the Quick Identification skill feat.
